# journal grammar

@anchor A1 ("continues A0", attention: lane anchor)

@entry 2026-09-20-lane-block
  WHAT ::
    a lane WHAT as a block scalar
    over two lines
  RESULT: "an unknown lane field"
  THREAD: none

@entry 2026-09-20-lane-cont
  WHAT: "a lane entry with a continuation line"
  continuation prose at two spaces that is no field
  THREAD: none

@entry 2026-09-20-lane-canon
  WHAT: "a canonical lane entry"
  THREAD: none
  REF: "journal#2026-09-20-legacy-one"

@entry 2026-09-20-lane-repeat
  WHAT: "the first occurrence of a repeated lane slug"
  THREAD: none

@entry 2026-09-20-lane-repeat
  WHAT: "the second occurrence of a repeated lane slug"
  THREAD: none
